evidence: The film thickness and refractive index (R.I.) of the SiNx were measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry (M72000DI, J.A. Woolam). The spectra collected at three different incident angles (55°, 65°, and 75°) were analyzed using a silicon nitride Tauc-Lorentz oscillator model over a wavelength range of 275−1690 nm. The refractive index was reported at 633 nm. The mean value was determined by the average value of multi-point measurement at 9 different locations of the wafer.
